title: Social and news information
purpose: Study attention, sentiment, disagreement, novelty, and information diffusion under historical availability constraints.

readyWork.summary: Implement durable live dual-source feature materialization suitable for pre-outcome shadow forecasts.
deliverables: Durable infrastructure artifact for prospective-social-materialization
Evidence-linked task handoff
acceptanceCriteria: Implement durable live dual-source feature materialization suitable for pre-outcome shadow forecasts.
No epistemic stage is promoted without linked evidence

readyWork.summary: Audit manifests for an untouched historical social and market overlap before any event-conditioned directional development.
deliverables: Manifest-only inventory of historical social and market overlap without reading target rows
Exact opened-outcome overlap analysis and a DATA_FEASIBILITY evidence record
Candidate update that either identifies an untouched segment or records DATA_BLOCKED
acceptanceCriteria: No target-bearing feature rows or confirmation outcomes are opened
Every candidate period is checked against the opened-outcome inventory
No future-data waiting is proposed

readyWork.summary: Run the registered eight-variant event-conditioned signed-social family on development-only outcomes.
externalBlockers: Disagreement-change has only 87 acted rows in chronological fold one versus the registered minimum of 100; the opened family cannot be narrowed post hoc.
deliverables: Complete eight-variant trial ledger with failures retained
Chronological purged development report against every registered baseline
Evidence-linked decision to freeze, reject, or remain inconclusive
acceptanceCriteria: Only periods registered as development are opened
One process, two BLAS threads, eight primary variants, and no GPU
No subgroup or secondary metric is promoted after outcomes

readyWork.summary: Freeze one exact event-conditioned social candidate and its single-use untouched historical confirmation.
externalBlockers: The registered eight-variant development family failed its pre-model coverage gate.
deliverables: Write-once lock binding target, features, availability, model, costs, inference, and period
Freeze artifact with implementation, model, panel, and lock SHA-256 identities
Empty single-use confirmation ledger
acceptanceCriteria: Candidate is FROZEN_CANDIDATE before confirmation becomes ready
Confirmation period is exact and absent from the opened-outcome inventory
No future observations or adaptive stopping are required

readyWork.summary: Autonomously open the exact single-use historical confirmation only after every frozen gate passes.
deliverables: Atomic confirmation marker in the registered empty ledger
Immutable dependence-aware family result
Candidate, evidence, opened-outcome, compute, and decision-log updates
acceptanceCriteria: Freeze SHA-256, implementation, model, panel, lock, and ledger identities pass
Exact period has no overlap with any opened outcome
Result is reported at the earned epistemic stage without retuning

readyWork.summary: Preregister a materially distinct polarity-shock-only directional candidate without reusing disagreement or changing the opened V1 family.
deliverables: Exact polarity-shock-only candidate contract with a new candidate ID
Bias ledger, bounded family, rejection gates, and prospective activation contract
acceptanceCriteria: No target-bearing row from the consumed period is read while writing the contract
The new candidate is materially distinct and does not reinterpret V1 subgroups as confirmation
Prospective waiting remains disabled until development passes and one candidate is frozen

readyWork.summary: Run the registered four-variant polarity-shock family once on explicitly contaminated historical development outcomes.
deliverables: Complete four-variant trial ledger with failures retained
Chronological purged development report against every registered baseline
Evidence-linked decision to freeze, reject, or remain blocked
acceptanceCriteria: Use only the registered polarity feature, horizons, estimators, attention gate, folds, and baselines
One process, two BLAS threads, four primary variants, and no GPU
Historical evidence remains capped at EXPLORATORY
No subgroup, horizon, estimator, or secondary metric is promoted after outcomes

readyWork.summary: Freeze the exact winning polarity-shock candidate only after every development gate passes.
externalBlockers: All four V2 variants failed development forecast-loss and stability gates; candidate is REJECTED.
deliverables: Write-once candidate lock and artifact identities
Prospective feature-publication and outcome-sealing contract
acceptanceCriteria: Candidate is frozen without reading new outcomes
All four development variants remain in the trial ledger
Prospective activation remains false until outcome sealing is operational
